attractions.name: Registan Square
attractions.description: Heart of the Timurid Empire, framed by the Ulugh Beg Madrasa (1417–1420), Sher-Dor Madrasa (tiger mosaics) and Tilya-Kori Madrasa (golden mosque interior).
tips: Visit both by day for architectural detail and in the evening for the light show
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Registan Light & Sound Show
attractions.description: Evening projection lighting, narration and traditional music telling the story of Samarkand and the Timurid Empire.
attractions.hours: Typically 2D light show around 8:30 PM and laser projections around 9:00 PM
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Gur-e-Amir Mausoleum
attractions.description: Final resting place of Amir Temur, his sons and grandson Ulugh Beg; fine Timurid architecture with a turquoise dome and mosaics.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Amir Temur Square (Amir Temur St)
attractions.description: Square with a large statue of Amir Temur, surrounded by gardens and historic buildings.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Ulugh Beg Observatory
attractions.description: 15th-century observatory built by astronomer Ulugh Beg, which once housed a massive sextant used to map the stars.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Shah-i-Zinda Necropolis
attractions.description: Avenue of mausoleums with blue tiles and geometric patterns, containing tombs of Timurid royal family members and nobles; the name means 'The Living King'.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx

attractions.name: Siyob Bazaar
attractions.description: Largest traditional market in Samarkand near Registan, selling dried fruits, nuts, bread (non), sweets, spices, handicrafts and souvenirs.
attractions._source_file: Almaty Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan and Kazhakstan- All Inclusive Guide_13032026.docx
